items.title: What is the average cost of teeth whitening?

items.text: Professional teeth whitening generally costs between $300 and $1,000+ per session, with an average in-office visit (like Zoom) costing around $500–$600. Laser whitening is typically higher, ranging from $450 to over $1,500. Dentist-supervised take-home trays usually range from $100 to $600, while over-the-counter kits are the cheapest option at $5–$150.

items.title: Key Cost Factors and Options:
items.text: In-Office Whitening : $300–$1,500 (fastest results, highest cost). Custom Take-Home Trays : $100–$600 (professional grade, gradual results). Over-the-Counter (OTC) : $5–$150 (strips, gels, kits). Location: Costs can vary by city; for example, in-office whitening in New York City can be $99–$599, while in other areas, it may exceed $1,000. Insurance: Teeth whitening is considered cosmetic, so it is rarely covered by dental insurance.

items.title: Professional vs. OTC Results
items.text: In-Office: Up to 8 shades lighter in 60–90 minutes. At-Home Professional: Noticeable results in 1–2 weeks. OTC Products: 1–2 shades lighter over 2–4 weeks.
